title: Spectral sparsity under subspace restriction
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $H\le V$, and let $f:V\to\mathbb{R}$. The number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of the restriction of $f$ to $H$ is at most the number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$
